name: autonr
description: Let an AI agent trade without trusting it: an on-chain AgentVault on Hedera prices every SaucerSwap V2 trade with Chainlink, requires Supra to agree, enforces caps on-chain, and only trades against reasoning the agent published to HCS first. Foundry + Next.js + TypeScript agent with an independent verifier.

steps.label: Start the dashboard: live Chainlink and Supra prices, the guardrail playground and trade proofs
See how the vault's oracle guard judges the live SaucerSwap pool (read-only)

sections.title: Run your own guarded agent on Hedera testnet

steps.label: Create an ECDSA testnet account and fund it
Import that key as the deployer
Create the agent account and its HCS decision topic, and wire them into the vault
steps.text: Put OPERATOR_ACCOUNT_ID and OPERATOR_PRIVATE_KEY in packages/agent/.env first (see packages/agent/.env.example).

steps.label: Check everything before the first trade
Run one decision: publish the reasoning to HCS, then trade through the vault

steps.text: Deploys and fork tests need Foundry below 1.8 (foundryup -i v1.7.1): the Hedera JSON-RPC relay rejects the block parameters newer forge sends.
